subject: 飛行員知識 - 機場營運與地面安全 (Airport Operations)

mc_questions.zh_question: 在管制機場（Towered Airport）運作時，若飛行員因緊急情況必須偏離航管（ATC）指示，應如何處理？
zh_options: (A) 無須告知航管，因為緊急情況具有優先權
(B) 僅在航管主動詢問時才說明偏離原因
(C) 必須在偏離後儘速（as soon as possible）告知航管
(D) 偏離前必須先獲得航管的書面核准
mc_questions.en_question: When operating at a towered airport, if a pilot must deviate from an ATC instruction in an emergency, what action is required?
en_options: (A) No notification is needed as emergencies have priority
(B) Explain only if ATC specifically asks for the reason
(C) Must advise ATC of the deviation as soon as possible
(D) Must obtain written approval before deviating
mc_questions.explanation: 根據法規與系統邏輯，飛行員在緊急情況（Emergency）下有權偏離航管指示，但必須儘速向航管單位（ATC）通報該偏離行為，以利空間管理與飛安維護。

mc_questions.zh_question: 關於「位移跑道頭」（Displaced Threshold）的敘述，下列何者正確？
zh_options: (A) 位移區段完全禁止任何飛機進入
(B) 位移區段可用於起飛、爬升及計程（Taxi），但不能用於著陸（Landing）
(C) 位移區段僅供緊急降落使用
(D) 位移跑道頭會增加該方向的著陸距離
mc_questions.en_question: Which of the following is true regarding a Displaced Threshold?
en_options: (A) The displaced area is strictly prohibited for all aircraft entry
(B) It is available for takeoffs, climb-outs, and taxiing, but not for landings from that direction
(C) It is reserved exclusively for emergency landings
(D) A displaced threshold increases the landing distance available for that runway
mc_questions.explanation: Displaced Threshold（位移跑道頭）將降落觸地點延後，通常是為了避開障礙物。位移後的區段可用於 Taxi、Takeoff，但該方向的 Landing 必須在 Threshold Bar 之後進行，這會減少可用降落距離（Landing Distance Available）。

mc_questions.zh_question: 在非管制機場（Non-towered Airport）加入起落航線（Traffic Pattern）時，最建議的加入方式為何？
zh_options: (A) 直接從跑道上方 500 呎切入
(B) 以 45 度角切入三邊（Downwind leg）的中段
(C) 以 90 度角垂直切入五邊（Final approach）
(D) 隨意切入，只要不影響其他飛機即可
mc_questions.en_question: What is the preferred method for entering the traffic pattern at a non-towered airport?
en_options: (A) Cross directly over the runway at 500 feet
(B) Enter at a 45-degree angle to the downwind leg at midfield
(C) Enter at a 90-degree angle to the final approach
(D) Enter at any point as long as other traffic is not affected
mc_questions.explanation: 為確保交通流量順暢與目視發現其他飛機，FAA 建議以 45 度角切入三邊（Downwind leg）的中段（Midfield），這是標準且最容易觀察流量的方式。

mc_questions.zh_question: 當飛機脫離跑道時，在何種情況下才被視為完全脫離跑道安全區域（RSA）？
zh_options: (A) 當飛機的前輪越過跑道邊緣線時
(B) 當飛機的機頭對準滑行道中心線時
(C) 當整個飛機機身完全通過等待位置標誌與地面標線後
(D) 當塔台確認飛機已完全進入滑行道後
mc_questions.en_question: When exiting a runway, at what point is the aircraft considered clear of the runway safety area (RSA)?
en_options: (A) When the aircraft's nose wheel crosses the runway edge line
(B) When the aircraft's nose is aligned with the taxiway centerline
(C) When the entire aircraft has passed the holding position sign and the accompanying surface painted marking
(D) When the tower controller confirms the aircraft is fully on the taxiway
mc_questions.explanation: 根據法規，必須飛機整體（entire aircraft）完全越過 Runway holding position marking（包含兩條實線與兩條虛線）後，才視為正式脫離跑道。Exiting 時是從虛線側（dashed lines）移動至實線側。

mc_questions.zh_question: 關於落地後短距停留作業（LAHSO）的許可，下列敘述何者正確？
zh_options: (A) 機長（PIC）對 LAHSO 的許可擁有最終決定權，可決定接受或拒絕
(B) 只要塔台核發 LAHSO 許可，飛機必須強制執行
(C) LAHSO 許可僅能在側風超過 25 節時核發
(D) 學生飛行員單飛時也獲授權執行 LAHSO
mc_questions.en_question: Regarding the Land and Hold Short Operations (LAHSO) clearance, which of the following is correct?
en_options: (A) The Pilot in Command (PIC) has the final authority to accept or decline any LAHSO clearance
(B) Once ATC issues a LAHSO clearance, compliance is mandatory
(C) LAHSO clearances are only issued when crosswinds exceed 25 knots
(D) Student pilots are authorized to conduct LAHSO during solo flights
mc_questions.explanation: 機長（PIC）對 LAHSO 擁有最終否決權，若認為性能或安全距離不足，應拒絕該許可。此外，學生飛行員單飛（solo flight）時不被授權參與 LAHSO。

mc_questions.zh_question: 塔台通常在何種條件下會要求飛機在 ILS 關鍵區域（ILS Critical Area）標線前等待？
zh_options: (A) 當跑道長度不足 5000 呎時
(B) 當氣象條件不佳（如低雲或低能見度），需要保護儀降信號品質時
(C) 僅在執行非精確進場（Non-precision approach）時
(D) 當滑行道上的飛機數量超過 5 架時
mc_questions.en_question: Under what conditions will ATC typically instruct aircraft to hold short of the ILS Critical Area?
en_options: (A) When the runway length is less than 5000 feet
(B) During poor weather conditions (low ceiling or low visibility) to protect the integrity of ILS signals
(C) Only when a non-precision approach is being performed
(D) When there are more than 5 aircraft on the taxiway
mc_questions.explanation: 在惡劣天氣下，為了防止地面滑行的飛機干擾 Instrument Landing System (ILS) 的信號傳輸，ATC 會保護 ILS critical area，確保進場飛性能獲得穩定信號。

mc_questions.zh_question: 在具備儀表進場能力的跑道上，跑道邊燈（Runway Edge Lights）在接近跑道末端時的顏色變化規則為何？
zh_options: (A) 全程保持白色，直到跑道盡頭變為紅色
(B) 在最後 3,000 呎變為紅、白相間
(C) 在最後 2,000 呎或跑道長度的一半（取其短者）變為黃色（Amber）
(D) 僅在跑道入口處顯示綠色，其餘皆為白色
mc_questions.en_question: On instrument runways, what is the color coding for runway edge lights as they approach the end of the runway?
en_options: (A) Steady white until the end where they turn red
(B) Alternate red and white for the last 3,000 feet
(C) Yellow (amber) for the last 2,000 feet or half the runway length, whichever is less
(D) Green at the threshold and white for the remainder
mc_questions.explanation: 根據系統規範，儀表跑道的 Runway Edge Lights 在最後 2,000 呎或跑道長度的一半（取較短值）會由白色轉為黃色（Amber），以提醒飛行員即將到達跑道末端。跑道末端標示燈則為紅色。

mc_questions.zh_question: 跑道中心線燈系統（RCLS）在跑道末端 3,000 呎至 1,000 呎之間的顏色顯示為何？
zh_options: (A) 全白色（Steady White）
(B) 紅、白相間（Alternate Red and White）
(C) 全紅色（Steady Red）
(D) 黃、白相間（Alternate Amber and White）
mc_questions.en_question: What is the color of the Runway Centerline Lighting System (RCLS) from the 3,000-foot point to the 1,000-foot point of the runway?
en_options: (A) Steady white
(B) Alternate red and white
(C) Steady red
(D) Alternate amber and white
mc_questions.explanation: RCLS 從跑道入口開始為白色，直到剩下 3,000 呎時開始紅白相間（Alternate Red and White），而在最後 1,000 呎則變為全紅（Steady Red），提供剩餘距離的視覺參考。

mc_questions.zh_question: 關於跑道狀態燈（Runway Status Lights, RWSL）的邏輯，下列敘述何者正確？
zh_options: (A) RWSL 燈亮表示飛行員已獲得進入跑道的許可（Clearance）
(B) 跑道進入燈（REL）亮紅燈表示有衝突交通量，不應進入或穿越跑道
(C) 起飛等待燈（THL）亮起時，飛行員應立即加大油門起飛
(D) RWSL 系統由 ATC 人工控制開關
mc_questions.en_question: Regarding the logic of Runway Status Lights (RWSL), which statement is correct?
en_options: (A) Illuminated RWSL indicates the pilot has received clearance to enter the runway
(B) Red Runway Entrance Lights (REL) indicate conflicting traffic; do not enter or cross the runway
(C) Pilots should apply takeoff thrust immediately when Takeoff Hold Lights (THL) are illuminated
(D) The RWSL system is manually controlled by ATC
mc_questions.explanation: RWSL 是一種自動化警示系統。Runway Entrance Lights (REL) 亮紅燈表示有其他飛機正高速使用該跑道，嚴禁進入。RWSL 僅提供狀態警告，不代表 ATC 的核准（Clearance）。

mc_questions.zh_question: 關於四面體 (Tetrahedron) 著陸方向指示器的描述,下列何者正確?
zh_options: (A) 四面體的大端指向著陸方向
(B) 四面體的小端指向著陸方向
(C) 當塔台與四面體指示不一致時,應以四面體為準
(D) 四面體用於指示風速而非風向
mc_questions.en_question: Which of the following descriptions regarding a tetrahedron landing direction indicator is correct?
en_options: (A) The large end of the tetrahedron points in the direction of landing
(B) The small end of the tetrahedron points in the direction of landing
(C) When tower instructions conflict with tetrahedron indications, the tetrahedron takes precedence
(D) A tetrahedron is used to indicate wind speed rather than direction
mc_questions.explanation: 四面體的小端 (small end) 指向著陸方向。在有塔台的機場,若塔台正在運作,塔台指令優先於四面體的指示 (Tower instructions supersede tetrahedron indications)。

mc_questions.zh_question: 根據教材,螺旋槳動力飛機與軍用噴射機 (Turbojet) 的機場流量模式 (Traffic Pattern) 高度通常有何差異?
zh_options: (A) 螺旋槳飛機高度較高,通常為 2,500 呎 AGL
(B) 軍用噴射機高度較低,通常為 600 呎 AGL
(C) 螺旋槳飛機通常為 1,000 呎 AGL,軍用噴射機可能高達 2,500 呎 AGL
(D) 兩者在所有機場的標準高度皆統一為 1,500 呎 AGL
mc_questions.en_question: According to the manual, what is the typical difference in traffic pattern altitudes between propeller-driven aircraft and military turbojet aircraft?
en_options: (A) Propeller aircraft fly higher, usually at 2,500 feet AGL
(B) Military turbojets fly lower, usually at 600 feet AGL
(C) Propeller aircraft are usually at 1,000 feet AGL, while military turbojets may extend up to 2,500 feet AGL
(D) Both have a standardized altitude of 1,500 feet AGL at all airports
mc_questions.explanation: 一般螺旋槳飛機流量模式高度通常為 1,000 呎 AGL,而軍用噴射機因速度快,其模式高度常延伸至 2,500 呎 AGL。飛行員應查閱 Chart Supplement U.S. 以確認特定機場高度。

mc_questions.zh_question: 若飛行員欲進入 Class D 空域但發現無線電接收機故障 (Lost Communications),應採取何種程序?
zh_options: (A) 立即降落於空域外之農田
(B) 留在空域外或上方,直到確定交通流向後再進入模式並觀察燈號
(C) 盲發 (Transmitting blind) 宣告緊急後直接切入 Final
(D) 保持原有高度與航向,直到塔台主動聯絡
mc_questions.en_question: If a pilot experiences a receiver failure (lost communications) before entering Class D airspace, what procedure should be followed?
en_options: (A) Land immediately in a field outside the airspace
(B) Remain outside or above the Class D airspace until the flow of traffic is determined, then enter the pattern and watch for light signals
(C) Transmit blind to declare an emergency and cut directly to final
(D) Maintain original altitude and heading until the tower initiates contact
mc_questions.explanation: 當無線電失效時,飛行員應留在 Class D 空域外或其上方 (outside or above),觀察其他飛機以判斷交通流向,隨後進入流量模式並觀察塔台的燈號指令 (Light Gun Signals)。

mc_questions.zh_question: 關於次要搜索雷達 (Secondary Radar / ATCRBS) 的系統組成,不包含下列哪一項?
zh_options: (A) 詢問器 (Interrogator)
(B) 答詢機 (Transponder)
(C) 雷達顯示屏 (Radarscope)
(D) 衛星全球定位系統 (GPS)
mc_questions.en_question: Which of the following is NOT a component of the Air Traffic Control Radar Beacon System (ATCRBS)?
en_options: (A) Interrogator
(B) Transponder
(C) Radarscope
(D) Global Positioning System (GPS)
mc_questions.explanation: 次要搜索雷達 (ATCRBS) 由三個部分組成:詢問器 (Interrogator)、答詢機 (Transponder) 和雷達顯示屏 (Radarscope)。GPS 是 ADS-B 系統主要使用的定位來源,而非傳統 ATCRBS 的組成部分。

mc_questions.zh_question: 根據音訊內容，在哪種飛機配置與飛行狀態下，所產生的尾流（Wake Turbulence）強度最高？
zh_options: (A) 重型、高速、襟翼全放（Dirty）
(B) 輕型、低速、襟翼收起（Clean）
(C) 重型、低速、襟翼收起（Clean）
(D) 重型、低速、襟翼全放（Dirty）
mc_questions.en_question: According to the audio, under which aircraft configuration and flight state is the wake turbulence generated the strongest?
en_options: (A) Heavy, high speed, dirty configuration
(B) Light, slow speed, clean configuration
(C) Heavy, slow speed, clean configuration
(D) Heavy, slow speed, dirty configuration
mc_questions.explanation: 尾流強度與飛機重量成正比，與速度成反比。最大的 Vortex Strength 出現在飛機處於 Heavy（重型）、Slow（慢速）且 Clean（襟翼與起落架收起的潔淨配置）時，因為 Dirty 配置產生的擾動會加速尾流衰減（Vortex Decay）。

mc_questions.zh_question: 當跟隨在一架大型飛機後方準備在同一條跑道降落時，飛行員應採取何種避讓程序？
zh_options: (A) 保持在大型飛機的飛行路徑下方，並在其著陸點前觸地
(B) 保持在大型飛機的飛行路徑上方，並在其著陸點之後觸地
(C) 保持與大型飛機相同的下滑道，並在相同點觸地
(D) 快速下降以避開大型飛機的航跡
mc_questions.en_question: When landing behind a larger aircraft on the same runway, what avoidance procedure should the pilot follow?
en_options: (A) Stay below the large aircraft's flight path and touch down before its touchdown point
(B) Stay at or above the large aircraft's flight path and land beyond its touchdown point
(C) Maintain the same glide path and land at the same point
(D) Descend rapidly to avoid the wake trail
mc_questions.explanation: 為了避開向下沉降的翼尖渦流（Wingtip Vortices），飛行員應保持在領先飛機的下滑路徑（Flight Path）之上，並確保觸地點在大型飛機觸地點之後，以避開其產生的尾流區域。

mc_questions.zh_question: 關於有效的空中交通掃描（Visual Scanning）以預防碰撞，下列敘述何者正確？
zh_options: (A) 應使用連續且快速的眼球掃視動作
(B) 每次眼球移動不應超過 10 度，且應停頓至少 1 秒以進行偵測
(C) 掃描時應專注於儀表而非外部交通
(D) 只需掃描飛機正前方 30 度的範圍
mc_questions.en_question: Regarding effective visual scanning for collision avoidance, which of the following is correct?
en_options: (A) Use continuous and rapid sweeping eye movements
(B) Each movement should not exceed 10 degrees and should be observed for at least 1 second
(C) Focus on instruments rather than outside traffic during scanning
(D) Only scan the area 30 degrees directly in front of the aircraft
mc_questions.explanation: 有效的掃描是由一系列短促、規律的眼球移動組成，每個區塊（Segment）不超過 10 度，並停頓至少 1 秒，這樣才能讓眼睛的中央視野（Central Visual Field）有效偵測到其他飛機的存在。

mc_questions.zh_question: 在不熟悉的機場或低能見度情況下滑行，飛行員應如何主動降低跑道侵入（Runway Incursion）風險？
zh_options: (A) 僅依賴電子導航設備，減少對外觀察
(B) 請求進階滑行（Progressive Taxi）指令
(C) 為了不占用頻道，即使不確定路徑也不詢問 ATC
(D) 快速滑行以儘早離開複雜區域
mc_questions.en_question: When taxiing at an unfamiliar airport or during low visibility, how should a pilot proactively mitigate the risk of runway incursion?
en_options: (A) Rely solely on electronic navigation and reduce outside lookout
(B) Request progressive taxi instructions
(C) Avoid asking ATC even if unsure of the route to save airtime
(D) Taxi at high speed to exit complex areas quickly
mc_questions.explanation: 飛行員可以請求 Progressive Taxi 指令，管制員將提供 step-by-step 的導航引導。此外，應隨時準備好 current airport diagram 並維持 SA (Situational Awareness)。

mc_questions.zh_question: 關於 ATC 發出的「Line Up and Wait (LUAW)」指令，下列敘述何者正確？
zh_options: (A) LUAW 視同起飛許可（Takeoff Clearance）
(B) 它是為了取代傳統的「Position and Hold」用法
(C) 進入跑道後若無起飛許可，可自行決定起飛
(D) 此指令發出後，塔台不需告知延遲起飛的原因
mc_questions.en_question: Regarding the ATC instruction 'Line Up and Wait (LUAW)', which statement is correct?
en_options: (A) LUAW is considered a Takeoff Clearance
(B) It was implemented to replace the traditional 'Position and Hold' phraseology
(C) Pilots can decide to take off on their own after entering the runway if no clearance follows
(D) The tower is not required to advise the reason for the takeoff delay after issuing this instruction
mc_questions.explanation: LUAW 取代了舊有的 Position and Hold。LUAW 僅是授權進入跑道等待，並非 Takeoff Clearance。如果 LUAW 後超過 90 秒未收到起飛許可，必須聯繫 ATC。

mc_questions.zh_question: 落地後脫離跑道時，飛機在什麼狀態下才被視為「完全離開跑道（Clear of the Runway）」？
zh_options: (A) 只要機頭越過跑道邊緣線
(B) 當飛機所有部分都已越過 Hold Short 線（跑道等待位置標誌）
(C) 當主起落架越過 Hold Short 線
(D) 當飛機完全停穩並向塔台回報已脫離時
mc_questions.en_question: After landing and exiting a runway, at what point is the aircraft considered 'Clear of the Runway'?
en_options: (A) As soon as the nose passes the runway edge line
(B) When all parts of the aircraft have crossed the hold short line (Runway Holding Position Marking)
(C) When the main landing gear crosses the hold short line
(D) When the aircraft comes to a complete stop and reports vacated to the tower
mc_questions.explanation: 為了確保跑道安全區（RSA）淨空，飛機的所有部位（包括尾翼）都必須完全越過 Hold Short 標誌，才算離開跑道環境。

mc_questions.zh_question: 工程材料阻攔系統（EMAS）的主要運作原理是什麼？
zh_options: (A) 使用強力鋼纜攔截起落架
(B) 利用跑道末端的高坡度自然減速
(C) 使用輕質、可破碎的混凝土（Crushable Concrete）吸收飛機動能
(D) 噴灑高摩擦係數材料以增加輪胎抓地力
mc_questions.en_question: What is the primary operating principle of the Engineered Materials Arresting System (EMAS)?
en_options: (A) Using high-strength steel cables to snag the landing gear
(B) Utilizing high upward slopes at the end of the runway for natural deceleration
(C) Using lightweight, crushable concrete to absorb the aircraft's kinetic energy
(D) Spraying high-friction materials to increase tire grip
mc_questions.explanation: EMAS 安裝在跑道末端，當飛機衝出跑道（Overrun）時，輪胎會陷入可破碎的輕質混凝土床中，透過材料破碎產生的阻力來安全減速，將損害降至最低。

cloze_items.cloze_text: Runway numbers are in reference to {{c1::magnetic}} north.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 跑道編號是參考磁北極的方向。
cloze_items.explanation: 跑道號碼是根據跑道中心線相對於磁北（Magnetic North）的方位角前兩位數取四捨五入。

cloze_items.cloze_text: The Chart Supplement U.S. is published in seven books and are revised every {{c1::56}} days.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 美國航圖補給（Chart Supplement U.S.）分為七冊出版，且每 56 天修訂一次。
cloze_items.explanation: 這是飛行員獲取機場設施、燈光、通訊頻率最精確數據的來源，必須確保版本有效。

cloze_items.cloze_text: An ATIS message is normally updated once per hour but is updated more often when changing {{c1::local conditions}} warrant.
cloze_items.zh_translation: ATIS 訊息通常每小時更新一次，但當當地情況變化有必要時，會更頻繁地更新。
cloze_items.explanation: 例如天氣突然惡化或跑道臨時關閉時，ATIS 會立即重新錄製並更新代碼。

cloze_items.cloze_text: Yellow {{c1::arrowheads}} are placed across the width of the runway just prior to a relocated threshold bar.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 黃色箭頭標記會橫跨跑道寬度，設置在移位跑道頭標線之前。
cloze_items.explanation: 移位跑道頭（Relocated Threshold）區段僅供計程（Taxi）使用，絕對禁止起飛或降落。

cloze_items.cloze_text: The Runway Safety Area (RSA) boundary sign has a {{c1::yellow}} background with black markings.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 跑道安全區（RSA）邊界指示牌具有黃色背景與黑色標記。
cloze_items.explanation: 當飛機離開跑道進入滑行道時，看見此牌背面的標誌代表已完全離開跑道保護區域。

cloze_items.cloze_text: The {{c1::Runway Safety Area}} (RSA) is a surface surrounding the runway prepared for reducing the risk of damage in the event of an undershoot or overshoot.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 跑道安全區域 (RSA) 是指跑道周圍經過處理的表面，用於降低飛機在落地不足 (undershoot) 或衝出跑道 (overshoot) 時受損的風險。
cloze_items.explanation: RSA 是機場基礎設施中重要的安全緩衝區，不可堆放障礙物。

cloze_items.cloze_text: Runway holding position signs have white characters on a {{c1::red}} background.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 跑道等待位置標誌在紅色背景上顯示白色字符。
cloze_items.explanation: 這是 Mandatory Instruction Signs (強制性標誌) 的特徵，類似道路上的停車標誌。

cloze_items.cloze_text: An ATC clearance is {{c1::not}} needed to cross the runway holding position marking when exiting the runway.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 當從跑道脫離（越過等待位置標線）時，不需要塔台的許可。
cloze_items.explanation: 從虛線側（dashed side）越過等待線不需要許可，但從實線側（solid side）進入跑道則必須獲得授權。

cloze_items.cloze_text: Pilots should only receive a LAHSO clearance when there is a minimum ceiling of 1,000 feet and {{c1::3}} statute miles of visibility.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 飛行員僅能在雲底高度至少 1,000 呎且能見度至少 3 哩時收受 LAHSO 許可。
cloze_items.explanation: 這是執行 LAHSO 的最低基本天氣限度，確保飛行員有足夠的視覺參考。

cloze_items.cloze_text: Temporarily closed runways are usually marked with a visual indication of a {{c1::yellow X}} at each end.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 暫時關閉的跑道通常會在每一端標註一個黃色的 X 符號作為視覺指示。
cloze_items.explanation: 這個標誌提醒飛行員該跑道目前不可用於起降，可能是由於維修或障礙物。

cloze_items.cloze_text: Visual Approach Slope Indicator (VASI) provides obstruction clearance within {{c1::10}} degrees of the extended runway centerline.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 目視進場坡度指示器 (VASI) 在跑道延伸中心線左右 10 度範圍內提供障礙物間隔。
cloze_items.explanation: VASI 的障礙物隔離（Obstruction Clearance）範圍是有角度限制的，超出此角度可能不安全。

cloze_items.cloze_text: VASI obstruction clearance is provided up to {{c1::4}} nautical miles from the runway threshold.
cloze_items.zh_translation: VASI 障礙物間隔保護範圍最遠可達距跑道頭 4 海浬處。
cloze_items.explanation: 飛行員應注意 VASI 的有效保護距離限制，超出此距離進場時需額外留意地形。

cloze_items.cloze_text: A civilian land airport beacon is identified by alternating {{c1::white and green}} light flashes.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 民用陸上機場的燈光旋轉標桿以白、綠交替閃光來識別。
cloze_items.explanation: 機場標桿（Airport Beacon）顏色組合可用於識別機場類型（如軍用、水上機場或直升機場）。

cloze_items.cloze_text: Stop bar lights consist of a row of {{c1::red}} uni-directional, steady-burning in-pavement lights across the taxiway.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 停止線燈（Stop bar lights）由橫跨滑行道的一排紅色、單向、常亮的嵌入式燈光組成。
cloze_items.explanation: Stop Bar 亮起時嚴禁穿越，直到 ATC 給予許可且燈光熄滅。

cloze_items.cloze_text: Land and Hold Short Lights (LAHSO) consist of a row of pulsing {{c1::white}} lights installed across the runway.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 「落地並在短距離前停住」燈（LAHSO）由橫跨跑道的一排脈動白色燈光組成。
cloze_items.explanation: LAHSO 燈光在執行此類特殊操作時才會開啟，若熄滅則表示當前未執行 LAHSO。

cloze_items.cloze_text: Runway distance remaining signs have a {{c1::black}} background with white numbers.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 跑道剩餘距離指示牌具有黑色背景與白色數字。
cloze_items.explanation: 數字代表剩餘跑道長度（以千呎為單位），黑色背景是其標準識別色。

cloze_items.cloze_text: Unless otherwise established, the standard traffic pattern altitude for propeller-driven aircraft is {{c1::1,000 feet AGL}}.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 除非另有規定,否則螺旋槳動力飛機的標準流量模式高度為地面上方 1,000 呎 (AGL)。
cloze_items.explanation: 這是最基本的機場流量模式高度基準,噴射機則通常更高。

cloze_items.cloze_text: A pilot who operates internationally is required to hold a Restricted Radiotelephone Operator Permit issued by the {{c1::FCC}}.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 在國際航線上運行的飛行員必須持有由聯邦通訊委員會 (FCC) 核發的受限無線電電話營運證。
cloze_items.explanation: 在美國境內飛行通常不需要此證,但國際飛行是法規要求的。

cloze_items.cloze_text: VHF aviation radios operate in the frequency range between 118.0 MHz and {{c1::136.975}} MHz.
cloze_items.zh_translation: VHF 航空無線電運作的頻率範圍介於 118.0 MHz 至 136.975 MHz 之間。
cloze_items.explanation: 這是民航使用的通訊頻段,採直線傳播 (Line of sight)。

cloze_items.cloze_text: The fastest radar updates occur every 4.7 seconds, while {{c1::ADS-B}} equipped aircraft update their position once a second.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 雷達最快每 4.7 秒更新一次,而配備 ADS-B 的飛機則每秒更新一次位置。
cloze_items.explanation: ADS-B 提供了比傳統雷達更高的精確度與更新頻率。

cloze_items.cloze_text: Primary radar relies on the reflected portion of the radio wave and cannot penetrate {{c1::solid objects}} such as mountains.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 一次雷達依賴無線電波的反射部分,且無法穿透山脈等固體障礙物。
cloze_items.explanation: 這解釋了雷達「直線傳播」限制與山區遮蔽效應 (Terrain masking)。

cloze_items.cloze_text: A transponder code consists of four numbers from 0 to 7, providing a total of {{c1::4,096}} possible codes.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 答詢機代碼由 0 到 7 的四位數字組成,共提供 4,096 組可能的代碼。
cloze_items.explanation: 這是 8 進位 (Octal) 系統的編碼組合數。

cloze_items.cloze_text: ADS-B equipment operating on 978 MHz is known as the {{c1::Universal Access Transceiver}} (UAT).
cloze_items.zh_translation: 運行於 978 MHz 的 ADS-B 設備被稱為通用接入收發機 (UAT)。
cloze_items.explanation: UAT 是專為通用航空設計的 ADS-B 資料鏈路，區別於 1090 MHz 的 ES 模式。

cloze_items.cloze_text: ATC issues traffic advisories based on the {{c1::12-hour clock}} from the aircraft.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 航管員根據飛機的 12 小時時鐘方位發布交通諮詢。
cloze_items.explanation: 這是航空慣例中用來快速描述相對方位（Relative Azimuth）的方式。

cloze_items.cloze_text: Vortices typically sink at a rate of {{c1::several hundred}} feet per minute.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 渦流通常以每分鐘數百英尺的速度下沉。
cloze_items.explanation: 了解下沉率有助於飛行員在垂直空間上規劃避讓路徑。

cloze_items.cloze_text: A light {{c1::quartering tailwind}} presents the worst case scenario for wake turbulence movement.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 輕微的側尾風（四分之一側尾風）是尾流移動最危險的情況。
cloze_items.explanation: 側尾風會將渦流推送到跑道中心線，並可能將其維持在飛機進場路徑上。

cloze_items.cloze_text: It is prudent to wait at least {{c1::2 minutes}} prior to a takeoff or landing behind a heavy aircraft in certain conditions.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 在某些情況下，在重型機後方起飛或降落前，謹慎的做法是至少等待 2 分鐘。
cloze_items.explanation: 這是為了預留足夠的時間讓尾流下沉、飄移或衰減。

cloze_items.cloze_text: Approximately {{c1::65%}} of all runway incursions are caused by pilots.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 大約有 65% 的跑道入侵事件是由飛行員造成的。
cloze_items.explanation: 統計數據強調了飛行員在地面運作中保持情境警覺（Situational Awareness）的重要性。

cloze_items.cloze_text: It is mandatory to read back all runway hold short instructions {{c1::verbatim}}.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 必須逐字複誦所有跑道等待（hold short）指令。
cloze_items.explanation: 這是預防跑道侵入最關鍵的溝通要求，確保飛行員正確理解等待位置。

cloze_items.cloze_text: All checklists should be completed while the aircraft is {{c1::stopped}} during taxi.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 滑行期間的所有檢查表應在飛機停止時完成。
cloze_items.explanation: 避免在移動滑行時低頭操作，以維持最高等級的對外觀察（Heads up）。

cloze_items.cloze_text: If you cannot safely comply with any of ATC's instructions, inform them immediately by using the word {{c1::UNABLE}}.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 如果您無法安全執行 ATC 的任何指令，請立即使用「UNABLE」一詞告知。
cloze_items.explanation: 飛行員擁有最終安全決定權，當指令危及安全或飛機能力不足時，必須明確拒絕。

cloze_items.cloze_text: Since June 30, 2010, ATC is required to issue explicit instructions to {{c1::cross}} or hold short of each runway.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 自 2010 年 6 月 30 日起，ATC 必須針對每一條跑道發出明確的「穿越」或「等待」指令。
cloze_items.explanation: 這項規定取消了以往一次滑行許可包含多個跑道穿越的情況，強制分段確認。

cloze_items.cloze_text: If a takeoff clearance is not received within {{c1::90}} seconds after receiving the LUAW instruction, contact ATC immediately.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 在收到 LUAW 指令後，若 90 秒內未收到起飛許可，請立即聯繫 ATC。
cloze_items.explanation: 這是為了防止塔台忘記跑道上已有飛機在等待，避免後續落地飛機造成的相撞風險。

cloze_items.cloze_text: At most commercial airports, the RSA extends {{c1::1000}} feet beyond each end of the runway.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 在大多數民航機場，跑道安全區（RSA）從跑道兩端向外延伸 1000 英尺。
cloze_items.explanation: RSA 提供了一個平坦且無障礙的區域，以降低飛機衝出或提前著陸時的風險。
